//: Typechecks module-sources/, which the main tsconfig excludes. Do not run tsc against this file directly - it resolves @prisma/client to the core-only client, in which no module model exists. `npm run typecheck:modules` generates tsconfig.modules.generated.json, which repoints @prisma/client at a client built from every module schema, and runs tsc against that. NOTE: `exclude` must be overridden here - it is inherited from the base config and takes precedence over `include`, so without this the project matches zero files and reports a meaningless 0 errors.
//include: src/core/types holds global `.d.ts` declarations (the hook payload registry). Nothing imports them, so they only enter a program that lists them explicitly - without this line every module file sees UxwVendHookPayloads as undeclared.
